description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for the 'Consultations' screen tailored for patients to view and manage their appointments. It includes logic for fetching consultation and patient data via an API service, displaying a list of consultations, or an empty state if none are available.

classes.name: ConsultationsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that displays a list of patient consultations, fetching data asynchronously from an API.

classes.name: _ConsultationsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the data loading, UI state, and rendering for ConsultationsScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers data loading when the widget is inserted into the widget tree.

methods.name: _loadData
methods.description: Asynchronous method that fetches patient profile and consultation data from API, handles loading state, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, showing a loading indicator, empty state, or list of consultation cards.
